categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen VMAX New Energy (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy vehicle sector, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of new energy vehicle power domain products. Its main product lines include onboard power supplies such as onboard chargers, DC/DC converters, integrated power supply products, electric drive systems including motor controllers and integrated drive assemblies, electric vehicle communication controllers (EVCC), and liquid-cooled charging pile modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced power electronics technologies including magnetic integration control decoupling, output port circuit integration control, single-phase and three-phase charging compatibility, V2X inverter safety control, reverse pre-charging, high-efficiency cooling structural design, multi-in-one power domain controller technology, dual motor controller technology, third-generation semiconductor material applications, and 800V high-voltage platform development. Production emphasizes automation, intelligent manufacturing, and digital factory management with automated assembly lines and smart warehouses, enabling lean production and high-quality output.
categories.primary_customers_markets: VMAX serves leading domestic and international new energy vehicle manufacturers including XPeng Motors, Li Auto, Leapmotor, Lantu, Ideal Auto, Geely, Changan, Great Wall Motors, SAIC Group, Dongfeng Nissan, and global brands such as Stellantis Group, Renault, Aston Martin, and Ferrari. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and expanding overseas markets, supplying core components for electric vehicles and charging infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen and Wuhu, and has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Japan, France, Singapore, and plans for a production base in Thailand to serve Southeast Asian markets. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with increasing exports to Europe, America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: VMAX operates in the midstream segment of the new energy vehicle supply chain, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and integration of core electric vehicle components such as onboard power supplies and electric drive systems, supplying directly to OEMs (original equipment manufacturers).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous independent R&D and technological innovation, focusing on product integration, high voltage platforms, multi-functionality, and application of third-generation semiconductors. It invests heavily in R&D, with a dedicated team and multiple technology platforms covering hardware, software, system design, testing, product structure, and production processes. Strategic initiatives include expanding product lines, enhancing global market presence, advancing digital and automated manufacturing, and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: VMAX generates revenue primarily through direct sales of its new energy vehicle power domain products and electric drive systems to automotive OEMs. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts, including consignment (VMI) and non-consignment models, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also earns income from technical services related to product development and customization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: VMAX holds a leading position in the Chinese new energy vehicle onboard power supply market, ranking second with a 19% market share in passenger car onboard chargers and first with a 29.41% share in third-party supply shipments. It competes with traditional automotive parts suppliers, new energy vehicle OEMs' in-house suppliers, and other power electronics firms transitioning into the sector. The company is recognized for its technological leadership and strong customer relationships domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, VMAX achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.37 billion, representing a 15.39% year-over-year increase, driven by growth in new energy vehicle markets and expanded sales of integrated onboard power and electric drive systems. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 400 million, with a slight decline compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.69 billion, growing 6.36% year-over-year, and it maintains strong cash flow generation with operating cash inflows increasing by over 41%. R&D investment accounted for 6.05% of revenue, reflecting a growth focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VMAX emphasizes its core competitive advantages in technology innovation, product integration, and manufacturing automation. Its integrated onboard power products feature high power density, reduced size and weight, cost efficiency, and multi-functionality including V2X capabilities. The company’s proprietary magnetic integration and control algorithms, advanced cooling designs, and application of third-generation semiconductors differentiate its products. Additionally, VMAX’s global supply chain and strong OEM partnerships enhance its value proposition as a reliable, innovative supplier in the new energy vehicle industry.
